_about: GUI tooltips (plain language, USWDS principles: say what it does, units, and when it takes effect). 'widgets' is keyed by Qt objectName. 'json_scan' serves the Tomography/Diffraction tabs: keys are JSON paths joined by '__' ({axis} -> x/y); per-tab sections override 'shared'; 'groups' are groupBox_<kind>_<suffix>; 'buttons' use {kind}; {plan} and {overhead} are filled in by the GUI.

shared.scan_label: Short name for this scan. Used in the PDF report and the angle log file name.
shared.flying_panda: Use PandA-triggered fly scans. Leave on unless beamline staff advise otherwise.
shared.stop_iter: Reset to off when the scan starts. To stop a running scan, use Stop After Current Angle.
shared.pause_scan: Reset to off when the scan starts. To pause a running scan, use Pause.
shared.save_log_to: Folder for the angle log (CSV). A copy of each submitted JSON is saved in a subfolder here. QServer must be able to read this folder.
shared.add_angles: Extra angles (degrees) scanned after the main list, separated by commas.
shared.remove_angles: Angles (degrees) to skip, separated by commas. Each must match an angle in the list exactly. Can be changed during a scan with Apply Changes.
shared.stop_pdf: Turn on to skip adding each angle's XRF maps to the PDF report.
shared.pdf_elems: Elements whose maps are added to the PDF report, separated by commas. Reset to Defaults copies the live-plot elements.
shared.test: Test mode: skips the beam-dump and flux checks. Use only to test a JSON without beam.
shared.ic_threshold: Flux check (0-1). If IC3 drops below this fraction of its value at scan start, the beam is re-peaked before the next angle.
shared.Notes: Free-text notes saved with the scan parameters.
shared.angle_info__angle_step: Step between angles, in degrees. Must be greater than 0.
shared.fly2d_scan__det: Detector group recorded during the 2D scan.
shared.fly2d_scan__x_start: Start of the 2D scan in x, in µm.
shared.fly2d_scan__x_end: End of the 2D scan in x, in µm.
shared.fly2d_scan__y_start: Start of the 2D scan in y, in µm.
shared.fly2d_scan__y_end: End of the 2D scan in y, in µm.
shared.fly2d_scan__exposure: Dwell time per pixel, in seconds.
shared.{axis}align__do_align: Before each angle, run a 1D line scan in {axis} and recenter the sample in {axis}.
shared.{axis}align__start: Start of the {axis} alignment scan, in µm.
shared.{axis}align__end: End of the {axis} alignment scan, in µm.
shared.{axis}align__num: Number of points in the {axis} alignment scan.
shared.{axis}align__exposure: Dwell time per point, in seconds.
shared.{axis}align__elem: XRF element used to find the sample position.
shared.{axis}align__center_with: How the sample position is found. line_center: center of the signal above the threshold. edge: fit to the sample edge.
shared.{axis}align__threshold: line_center only (0-1). Signal below this fraction of the maximum is ignored.
shared.{axis}align__move_coarse: On: move the coarse stage by the correction. Off: move the scanning piezo to the new center.
shared.{axis}align__neg_flag: Invert the signal before finding the center. Use when the feature shows less signal than its surroundings.
shared.{axis}align__offset: Added to the found position before moving, in µm. Use to keep a feature deliberately off-center.
shared.{axis}align__zero_before_scan: Move the {axis} piezo to 0 before the alignment scan.
shared.{axis}align__initial_position: edge only. Expected edge position, in µm. Used with the movement limit.
shared.{axis}align__align_movement_limit: edge only. If the found edge is farther than this (µm) from the initial position, the fit is ignored and only the offset is applied.
shared.{axis}align__line_center_mode: line_center only. binary: every point above the threshold counts equally. as-is: points are weighted by signal.
shared.align_2d_com__do_align: Before each angle, run a small 2D map and recenter on the center of mass of the element signal.
shared.align_2d_com__x_start: Start of the alignment map in x, in µm.
shared.align_2d_com__x_end: End of the alignment map in x, in µm.
shared.align_2d_com__y_start: Start of the alignment map in y, in µm.
shared.align_2d_com__y_end: End of the alignment map in y, in µm.
shared.align_2d_com__exposure: Dwell time per pixel, in seconds.
shared.align_2d_com__elem: XRF element used to find the center of mass.
shared.align_2d_com__threshold: 0-1. Pixels below this fraction of the maximum are ignored.
shared.align_2d_com__move_x: Move the x piezo to the center of mass.
shared.align_2d_com__move_y: Move the y piezo to the center of mass.
shared.align_2d_com__x_offset: Added to the x center before moving, in µm.
shared.align_2d_com__y_offset: Added to the y center before moving, in µm.
shared.align_2d_com__zero_before_scan: Move both piezos to 0 before the alignment map.

tomo.axis_switch_angle: Angle (degrees) where the x scan switches piezo. Below it the x piezo scans; above it the z piezo scans.
tomo.scale_scan_range: On: widen the x range at each angle so the projected width stays the same. Off: keep the range and use fewer x points at high angles.
tomo.do_y_offset: MLL only. At each angle, correct dssy with the calibrated y-drift model.
tomo.th_init: Recorded automatically when the scan starts. The value here is not used.
tomo.y_init: Recorded automatically when the scan starts. The value here is not used.
tomo.angle_info__split_tomo: Interleave angles in this many passes. 2 scans every other angle, then fills the gaps. 1 scans in order.
tomo.fly2d_scan__x_start: Start of the 2D scan in x at 0 degrees, in µm. See 'scale scan range'.
tomo.fly2d_scan__x_end: End of the 2D scan in x at 0 degrees, in µm. See 'scale scan range'.
tomo.align_2d_com__do_align: Before each angle, run a small 2D map and recenter on the center of mass. Runs only when X Alignment is off.
tomo.align_using_previous__enable: Not used by run_tomo_json yet; saved in the JSON only.
tomo.align_using_previous__elem: XRF element for this correction. Not used by run_tomo_json yet.
tomo.align_using_previous__threshold: 0-1 signal threshold for this correction. Not used by run_tomo_json yet.
tomo.align_using_previous__apply_to: Motors to correct, separated by commas. Not used by run_tomo_json yet.
tomo.align_using_previous__move_x: Correct x. Not used by run_tomo_json yet.
tomo.align_using_previous__move_y: Correct y. Not used by run_tomo_json yet.

diff.custom_angle_list: Angles to scan (degrees), separated by commas. When set, they replace start/end/step in the summary. Note: run_diff_json does not read this list yet.

groups.xalign: Recenters the sample in x before each angle with a 1D line scan.
groups.yalign: Recenters the sample in y before each angle with a 1D line scan.
groups.align_2d_com: Recenters the sample before each angle with a small 2D map.
groups.align_using_previous: Not used by run_tomo_json yet. These values are only saved in the JSON.
groups.fly2d_scan: The angle range and the 2D map collected at every angle.
groups.summary: Estimate only. Includes about {overhead} s overhead per angle and updates as you edit.

buttons.pb_{kind}_import: Load parameters from a JSON file. Keys missing from the file keep their defaults.
buttons.pb_{kind}_export: Save the current parameters to a JSON file.
buttons.pb_{kind}_reset: Restore the default parameters. PDF elements are copied from the live plot.
buttons.pb_{kind}_preview: Show the JSON that will be sent to {plan}.
buttons.pb_run_{kind}_json: Start this scan on QServer now. Checks that QServer and its environment are running and saves a copy of the JSON first.
buttons.pb_send_{kind}_to_queue: Add this scan to the end of the QServer queue. It starts after earlier queue items finish. Pause, Stop, and Apply do not control queued scans.
buttons.pb_pause_{kind}: Pause before the next angle; the current angle finishes first. Click again to resume. Controls the last scan started with Run.
buttons.pb_stop_{kind}: End the scan after the current angle finishes. This cannot be undone.
buttons.pb_apply_{kind}: Send your edits to the running scan. They take effect from the next angle. Angle settings cannot change during a scan.

widgets.cb_change_energy_only: Move only the undulator gap and mono energy. DCM pitch/roll, HFM pitch and the mirror coating stay where they are. Use for small energy steps such as XANES.
widgets.cb_det_names_for_pos: Detector whose position Update Position would save. That button is disabled.

widgets.cb_erf_linear_flag: Add a sloped background to the edge fit. Turn on when the signal is not flat on either side of the edge.
widgets.cb_foucsScanMotor: Fine scanning motor for the line scan across the edge. Pick the axis that crosses the edge.
widgets.cb_linearFlag_zpFocus: Add a sloped background to the edge fit. Turn on when the signal is not flat on either side of the edge.
widgets.cb_linearflag_mll_focus: Add a sloped background to the edge fit. Turn on when the signal is not flat on either side of the edge.
widgets.cb_mll_focus_elem: XRF element of the edge feature used for the fit.
widgets.cb_mll_foucs_mtr: Fine scanning motor for the line scan across the edge. hz focus is usually found with dssx, vz focus with dssy.
widgets.cb_mll_rot_elem: XRF element of the feature to track. Choose one that appears only in that feature.
widgets.cb_mll_theta_for_diff: On: Copy Results records the MLL sample angle (dsth). Off: the ZP sample angle (zpsth).
widgets.cb_mll_z_motor: Motor stepped through focus: sbz (sample z), hz (horizontal lens z) or vz (vertical lens z).
widgets.cb_mll_z_motor_move: Not used yet: the Move button always moves sbz.
widgets.cb_motor1: Fast scanning motor: scans each line in 2D, or the only motor in a line scan.
widgets.cb_motor2: Slow motor in 2D: steps between lines. Not used in line scans.
widgets.cb_plot_elem: XRF element to plot or fit.
widgets.cb_queue_use_curr_pos: On: the queued scan returns to the current sample position. Off: it uses the values typed below.
widgets.cb_sid_moveZPZ: Also move the zone plate focus (ZPZ1) to the scan's value. Off: the focus stays where it is.
widgets.cb_sid_move_base_mll: Also move sbz (sample z) to the scan's position. Off: sbz stays where it is.
widgets.cb_target_coating: Mirror coating stripe chosen for the target energy (Cr, Pt, Si or Rh).
widgets.cb_technique_diff: Copy the nanodiffraction analysis scripts into the user folder (existing files are kept).
widgets.cb_tomo_live_elem_1: Element shown in the image above (sum of the three XRF detector channels).
widgets.cb_tomo_live_elem_2: Element shown in the image above (sum of the three XRF detector channels).
widgets.cb_tomo_live_elem_3: Element shown in the image above (sum of the three XRF detector channels).
widgets.cb_tomo_live_elem_4: Element shown in the image above (sum of the three XRF detector channels).
widgets.cb_zp_focus_elem: XRF element of the edge feature used for the fit (for example a Au or Pt line).
widgets.cb_zp_rot_elem: XRF element of the feature to track. Choose one that appears only in that feature.
widgets.cb_zp_rot_neg_flag: Invert the signal before finding the center. Use when the feature shows less signal than its surroundings.

widgets.db_move_dsy: Step size for dsy (coarse sample y), in µm.
widgets.db_move_dsz: Step size for dsz (coarse sample z), in µm.

widgets.db_s5_vcen_move: Step size for moving the S5 vertical center, in mm.

widgets.db_smarz: Current smarz (coarse sample z) position (live readback).

widgets.dsb_FocusScanDwell: Dwell time per point, in seconds.
widgets.dsb_ZPZ1TargetPos: Absolute ZPZ1 position to move to, in mm. Not relative.
widgets.dsb_ZPZ1TargetPos_energy: Estimated zone plate focus (ZPZ1) for the target energy, in mm. Calculated from a 10 keV reference; refine with a focus series.
widgets.dsb_flur_in_pos: IN position for the XRF detector, in mm, used by XRF Det IN. Closer gives more signal but risks hitting the optics.
widgets.dsb_hfm_target_pitch: Calculated HFM (horizontal focusing mirror) pitch for the target energy.
widgets.dsb_line_center_thre: 0-1. Signal below this fraction of the maximum is ignored by Return Line Center.
widgets.dsb_manual_roi_coarse_x: Position the queued 2D scan returns to: coarse x motor (named on the left; follows the microscope selection). Editable when Use Current Position is off.
widgets.dsb_manual_roi_coarse_y: Position the queued 2D scan returns to: coarse y motor (named on the left; follows the microscope selection). Editable when Use Current Position is off.
widgets.dsb_manual_roi_coarse_z: Position the queued 2D scan returns to: coarse z motor (named on the left; follows the microscope selection). Editable when Use Current Position is off.
widgets.dsb_manual_roi_fine_x: Position the queued 2D scan returns to: fine x motor (named on the left; follows the microscope selection). Editable when Use Current Position is off.
widgets.dsb_manual_roi_fine_y: Position the queued 2D scan returns to: fine y motor (named on the left; follows the microscope selection). Editable when Use Current Position is off.
widgets.dsb_manual_roi_fine_z: Position the queued 2D scan returns to: fine z motor (named on the left; follows the microscope selection). Editable when Use Current Position is off.
widgets.dsb_manual_roi_focus: Position the queued 2D scan returns to: focus motor (named on the left; follows the microscope selection). Editable when Use Current Position is off.
widgets.dsb_manual_roi_theta: Position the queued 2D scan returns to: theta motor (named on the left; follows the microscope selection). Editable when Use Current Position is off.
widgets.dsb_mll_foucs_mtr_end: Line scan end, in µm, relative to the current position.
widgets.dsb_mll_foucs_mtr_exp_time: Dwell time per point, in seconds.
widgets.dsb_mll_foucs_mtr_start: Line scan start, in µm, relative to the current position.
widgets.dsb_mll_foucs_mtr_steps: Number of points in each line scan. Fine steps give a better edge fit.
widgets.dsb_mll_z_target_pos: Absolute sbz position to move to, in µm.
widgets.dsb_move_diff_z_rel_value: Distance to move the detector stage along the beam (diff z), relative, in mm.
widgets.dsb_rot_align_dsth: Target dsth angle, in degrees, for its Move button (not connected yet).
widgets.dsb_rot_align_dsx: x correction for dsx, in µm. Filled in by Start.
widgets.dsb_rot_align_dsz: z correction for dsz, in µm. Filled in by Start.
widgets.dsb_rot_align_sbx: Correction for sbx, in µm: the opposite of the dsx correction. Filled in by Start.
widgets.dsb_rot_align_smarx: x correction (smarX), in µm. Filled in by Start; you can edit it. Applied by Apply Rot. Align. Correction.
widgets.dsb_rot_align_smarz: z correction (smarZ), in µm. Filled in by Start; you can edit it. Applied by Apply Rot. Align. Correction.
widgets.dsb_rot_align_zpsth: Target zpsth angle, in degrees, for Rotate to (not connected yet).
widgets.dsb_target_e: Target energy, in keV. Editing it updates the estimated undulator gap, mirror and pitch values below; nothing moves until you click Move.
widgets.dsb_target_pitch: Calculated DCM pitch for the target energy.
widgets.dsb_target_roll: Calculated DCM roll for the target energy.
widgets.dsb_target_ugap: Calculated undulator gap for the target energy, in µm.
widgets.dsb_zp_rot_threshold: 0-1. Signal below this fraction of the maximum is ignored when finding the center.
widgets.dwell: Exposure time per point, in seconds. Total time is about points x dwell, plus overhead.
widgets.gb_attenuators: Attenuators. Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.gb_create_user: Start a new experiment: sets the PI, experimenters and sample in the scan metadata, creates the user data folder and starts the PDF log.
widgets.gb_det_in_out: Move cameras and detectors in and out of the beam. Detector-tower moves open the hutch camera page and ask first.
widgets.gb_diff_stage: Point the diffraction detector at a Bragg peak: read the peak pixel on the Dexela, convert it to detector angles, then move the detector stage there.
widgets.gb_energy_estimates: Calculated for the target energy. You can check these before moving; they are not moved from here.
widgets.gb_energy_from_sid: Restore the energy settings recorded in an earlier scan.
widgets.gb_energy_optimize: Optional steps after an energy change.
widgets.gb_flatfield: Flat-field correction removes fixed patterns from camera images. Take it with the beam on an empty area.
widgets.gb_flyscan: Set up and run a PandA fly scan. The resolution, time estimate and plan text update as you edit.
widgets.gb_mll_focus: Find the MLL focus: at each z position, a line scan across a sharp edge is fitted, and the position with the smallest edge width (FWHM) is the focus.
widgets.gb_mll_navigation: Step the MLL sample stages. Type a step size, then click - or +. Each click moves immediately.
widgets.gb_mll_optics: MLL optics. Lenses, OSA and beam stops must be IN (near 0) for nanobeam. Each move checks positions first and refuses if an optic is not where it is expected.
widgets.gb_mll_osa_bs: Fine-adjust the MLL OSA and beam stop. Type a step size, then click - or +. Each click moves immediately, without confirmation. Near 0 is IN.
widgets.gb_mll_positions: Save, recall and share MLL sample positions.
widgets.gb_mll_rot_center: Put the MLL sample on the rotation axis. Line scans of a small feature at several angles give the x and z offsets from the axis; the correction moves dsx, dsz and sbx so the feature stays in place as the sample rotates.
widgets.gb_plotting: Plot, fit or find the center of a finished scan by scan ID and element.
widgets.gb_queue_server_plan: Send the fly scan set up above to the QServer queue, together with the sample position to return to before it runs.
widgets.gb_s5: S5 slit, just upstream of the optics. Sets the beam size that reaches the lens. All values in mm.
widgets.gb_set_energy: Change the X-ray energy. The estimated positions below update as you type, before anything moves.
widgets.gb_ssa2: SSA2, the secondary source aperture. Its gap sets the source size, which trades focus size against flux. All values in mm.
widgets.gb_techniques: Techniques used in this experiment. Each checked one gets its own folder when you create the user directory.
widgets.gb_tomo_live: XRF maps from the tomo scan, one image per angle, sorted by angle. New angles are read from the scan's angle log (CSV) every 10 minutes or on Update Now, saved as scan_<id>.npz in tomo_live_images next to the log, and displayed from there.
widgets.gb_troubleshooting: Recovery actions when the beam or the GUI is not behaving as expected.
widgets.gb_upstream_cameras: Upstream beam viewers. Move them out before measuring: they block or reduce the beam.
widgets.gb_xrf_elements: Choose which XRF elements are plotted during scans. Plotting only: the full XRF spectrum is always saved.
widgets.gb_zp_focus: Find the ZP focus: at each zone plate z (ZPZ1) position, a line scan across a sharp edge is fitted, and the position with the smallest edge width (FWHM) is the focus.
widgets.gb_zp_navigation: Step the ZP sample stages. Type a step size, then click - or +. Each click moves immediately.
widgets.gb_zp_optics: Zone plate optics. The OSA and beam stop must be IN (near 0) for nanobeam, and OUT for CAM11 viewing. Each move checks the current position first and refuses if the optic is already where you asked.
widgets.gb_zp_positions: Save, recall and share ZP sample positions.
widgets.gb_zp_rot_center: Put the ZP sample on the rotation axis. Line scans of a small feature at several angles give the x and z offsets of the feature from the axis; the correction moves the coarse stages so the feature stays in place as the sample rotates.
widgets.label_diff_progress: Progress of the diffraction scan started with Run, from its angle log: current angle, angles done and remaining (removed angles excluded), time per angle and estimated finish, based on the log timestamps.
widgets.label_tomo_live_frame: Angle, scan ID and position in the stack of the images shown.
widgets.label_tomo_live_status: Loading status. Scans that fail to load are listed and retried on the next update.
widgets.label_tomo_progress: Progress of the tomo scan started with Run, from its angle log: current angle, angles done and remaining (removed angles excluded), time per angle and estimated finish, based on the log timestamps.
widgets.le_experimenters: Names of the people running the experiment, separated by commas. Saved in the scan metadata and PDF log.
widgets.le_image_path: Full path to an image added to the start of the PDF log. Leave empty for no image.
widgets.le_line_elem: Element shown in the live line plot during 1D scans. Filled from the first element box.
widgets.le_live_elems: Elements shown in the live 2D plots: the first N element boxes, where N is the number on the left.
widgets.le_pdf_name: File name for the PDF log, without .pdf.
widgets.le_plot_sd: Scan ID to plot. -1 means the most recent scan.
widgets.le_proposal_num: NSLS-II proposal number (6 digits). Used by Get Proposal Info and Move Data to Globus.
widgets.le_qplan_name: Name for the queued scan. Saved with the scan so you can find it later.
widgets.le_roi_elems: All selected elements. These appear in the element menus elsewhere in the GUI (alignment, tomo, diffraction).
widgets.le_sample_name: Sample name. Saved in the scan metadata; scan names start as <sample>_1.
widgets.le_sid_position_mll: Scan ID for the buttons below. Negative numbers count back from the latest scan (-1 is the last).
widgets.le_sid_position_zp: Scan ID for the buttons below. Negative numbers count back from the latest scan (-1 is the last).
widgets.le_username: PI last name. Used to name the user data folder and saved as PI in the scan metadata.
widgets.mll_sample_roi_list_widget: Saved MLL sample positions. Double-click a name to rename it. The list is also saved automatically to /data/users/current_user/temp.
widgets.pb_2020: Fill in a 20 x 20 µm map, centered on the current position, 100 x 100 points, 5 ms dwell (50 ms for line scans).
widgets.pb_22: Fill in a 2 x 2 µm map, centered on the current position, 100 x 100 points, 5 ms dwell (50 ms for line scans).
widgets.pb_3030: Fill in a 28 x 28 µm map, centered on the current position, 56 x 56 points, 5 ms dwell (50 ms for line scans).
widgets.pb_66: Fill in a 6 x 6 µm map, centered on the current position, 100 x 100 points, 5 ms dwell (50 ms for line scans).
widgets.pb_CAM6_IN: Start CAM06 acquiring and move it into the beam (x = 0, y = 0 mm).
widgets.pb_CAM6_LASER: Stop CAM06 acquiring and move it to the laser alignment position (x = -34.8, y = 0.45 mm).
widgets.pb_CAM6_OUT: Stop CAM06 acquiring and move it out of the beam (x = -60 mm). Required before peaking the flux.
widgets.pb_FS_IN: Move the FS1 fluorescence screen into the beam (y = -57 mm) to see the beam position.
widgets.pb_FS_OUT: Move the FS1 fluorescence screen out of the beam (y = -20 mm).
widgets.pb_MoveZPZ1AbsPos: Move ZPZ1 to the New Focus Position (absolute). Asks for confirmation first.
widgets.pb_S5_Close: Set S5 to 0.3 x 0.3 mm, the usual nanobeam setting.
widgets.pb_S5_HClose: Set S5 to 0.1 mm horizontal x 0.3 mm vertical.
widgets.pb_S5_Open: Open S5 to 4 x 4 mm (H x V). Use for CAM11 viewing or beam finding.
widgets.pb_S5_VClose: Set S5 to 0.3 mm horizontal x 0.1 mm vertical.
widgets.pb_SSA2_Close: Set SSA2 to 0.05 x 0.03 mm (H x V), the nanobeam setting. Smaller gaps give a smaller focus but less flux.
widgets.pb_SSA2_HClose: Set SSA2 to 0.1 mm horizontal x 2.1 mm vertical, e.g. to center it horizontally.
widgets.pb_SSA2_Open: Open SSA2 to 2.1 x 2.1 mm (H x V). Use for beam finding or CAM11 viewing.
widgets.pb_SSA2_VClose: Set SSA2 to 2.1 mm horizontal x 0.1 mm vertical, e.g. to center it vertically.
widgets.pb_ZPZFocusScanStart: Run the focus series. When it finishes, the GUI shows the ZPZ1 position with the smallest FWHM and asks before moving there.
widgets.pb_abort_diff: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing. Use Stop CAM11 or Stop Merlin/Eiger to stop the stage.
widgets.pb_abort_fly: Stop the running scan: pauses, then aborts it after a few seconds. The data collected so far is kept.
widgets.pb_apply_zp_rot_align_corr: Move smarX and smarZ by the corrections (relative), and zpsx by the opposite x correction so the beam stays on the feature. No confirmation.
widgets.pb_batchscan_copy: Copy the scan command with 'yield from' in front, for use inside a batch plan.
widgets.pb_cam11IN: Move the detector stage so CAM11 is in the beam. Refused if the Dexela is in. Opens the hutch camera page and asks you to confirm the motion is safe first.
widgets.pb_cam11_flatfield: Save the current CAM11 image as the flat field and turn correction on. Move the beam to an empty area of the sample first.
widgets.pb_cam6IN: Start CAM06 acquiring and move it into the beam (x = 0, y = 0 mm).
widgets.pb_cam6OUT: Stop CAM06 acquiring and move it out of the beam (x = -60 mm). Required before peaking the flux.
widgets.pb_center_ssa2_auto: Center SSA2 on the beam: scans the vertical, horizontal, then vertical center (±0.05, ±0.05, ±0.02 mm) and moves each to the IC3 maximum. Needs beam on the sample.
widgets.pb_copy_curr_pos_mll: Copy the current MLL sample stage positions to the clipboard as text.
widgets.pb_copy_curr_pos_zp: Copy the current ZP sample stage positions to the clipboard as text.
widgets.pb_copy_pos2angle: Copy the sample angle, Dexela pixel and detector angles to the clipboard, for your notes.
widgets.pb_create_user: Create the user data folder, link it as current_user, start the PDF log, and set the PI, experimenters and sample for all following scans.
widgets.pb_dexela_IN: Move the Dexela area detector in (y = 0 mm). Opens the hutch camera pages and asks you to confirm the plastic cover is removed and the move is safe.
widgets.pb_dexela_OUT: Move the Dexela area detector out (y = 400 mm). Asks for confirmation first. The detector tower can only move when the Dexela is out.
widgets.pb_eiger_filter_a_in: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_eiger_filter_a_in_2: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_eiger_filter_a_out: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_eiger_filter_a_out_2: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_eiger_filter_b_in: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_eiger_filter_b_in_2: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_eiger_filter_b_out: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_eiger_filter_b_out_2: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_eiger_filter_c_in: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_eiger_filter_c_out: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_eiger_in: Move the detector stage so the Eiger is in the beam (position eiger_pos2). Refused if the Dexela is in. Opens the hutch camera page and asks you to confirm the motion is safe first.
widgets.pb_enable_run: Re-enable the Run button on the Data Acquisition tab if it stayed greyed out after an error. Check that no scan is running first.
widgets.pb_energy_change_w_sid: Turn beam feedback off and move the energy, gap and mono pitch to the values saved with that scan. Warning: it currently moves even if you answer No.
widgets.pb_engage_mirror_feedbacks: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_erf_fit: Fit an error function to the element signal of a line scan across an edge. Shows the edge position and beam size (FWHM).
widgets.pb_export_xrf_elem_list: Save the current element selection to a JSON file you choose.
widgets.pb_flatfield_disable: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing. For CAM11, use Disable CAM11 FlatField.
widgets.pb_flatfield_save_enable: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing. For CAM11, use Save+Enable CAM11 FlatField.
widgets.pb_flyplan_to_qserver: Add the fly scan above to the QServer queue. 1D: a plain line scan. 2D: moves to the saved position, then scans. Refused above 64,000 points. QServer must be running.
widgets.pb_get_current_position: Fill the boxes below with the current sample stage positions of the active microscope.
widgets.pb_get_proposal_info: Look up the proposal and fill in the PI last name, experimenters and sample name (the proposal title). Edit them before creating the user directory if needed.
widgets.pb_import_xrf_elem_list: Load an element selection from a JSON file. Click Apply Element Selection to use it.
widgets.pb_insert_user_image: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing. Type the image path in the box instead.
widgets.pb_laser_in: Intended to move CAM06 to the laser position. Currently fails: the GUI method it calls does not exist. Use Laser engage position on the Energy tab.
widgets.pb_light_OFF: Turn the microscope light off (power outlet 8).
widgets.pb_light_OFF_2: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_light_ON: Turn the microscope light on (power outlet 8). Turn it off before XRF measurements.
widgets.pb_light_ON_2: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_merlinIN: Move the detector stage so the Merlin is in the beam. Refused if the Dexela is in. Opens the hutch camera page and asks you to confirm the motion is safe first.
widgets.pb_merlinOUT: Move the whole detector tower (CAM11, Merlin, Eiger) to its OUT position. Refused if the Dexela is in. Opens the hutch camera page and asks you to confirm the motion is safe first.
widgets.pb_merlin_filterIN: Insert the Merlin filter to protect the detector from a strong beam. Checks the filter moved.
widgets.pb_merlin_filterIN_2: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_merlin_filterOUT: Remove the Merlin filter. Make sure the beam is not too strong for the detector first.
widgets.pb_merlin_filterOUT_2: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_mll_bs_in: Move both MLL beam stops in (bsx -500, bsy +500 µm). Refused if they are already near 0.
widgets.pb_mll_bs_out: Move both MLL beam stops out (bsx +500, bsy -500 µm). Refused unless both are near 0.
widgets.pb_mll_bsx_neg: Move the MLL beam stop x by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_mll_bsx_pos: Move the MLL beam stop x by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_mll_bsy_neg: Move the MLL beam stop y by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_mll_bsy_pos: Move the MLL beam stop y by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_mll_cam11_view: Switch the MLL microscope to CAM11 view. Requires all optics IN and the slits closed. Moves the XRF detector back, closes the fast shutter, moves beam stops, OSA and lenses out, opens SSA2 by 2 mm and S5 by 3.5 mm, then moves CAM11 in.
widgets.pb_mll_lens_in: Move both lenses in (vmll vy -500, hmll hx +500 µm). Refused if they are already near 0.
widgets.pb_mll_lens_out: Move both lenses out (vmll vy +500, hmll hx -500 µm). Refused unless both are near 0 and the XRF detector is more than 10 mm from the lens.
widgets.pb_mll_nanobeam: Switch the MLL microscope from CAM11 view to nanobeam. Requires the CAM11-view positions. Closes the fast shutter, closes SSA2 and S5, moves beam stops, OSA and lenses in, then moves the XRF detector in by 6 mm.
widgets.pb_mll_osa_in: Move the MLL OSA in: OSA X moves by -2600 µm. Refused if OSA X is already near 0.
widgets.pb_mll_osa_out: Move the MLL OSA out: closes the fast shutter, then OSA X moves by +2600 µm. Refused unless OSA X is near 0.
widgets.pb_mll_osax_neg: Move the MLL OSA x by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_mll_osax_pos: Move the MLL OSA x by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_mll_osay_neg: Move the MLL OSA y by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_mll_osay_pos: Move the MLL OSA y by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_mll_rot_align_start: Run the rotation alignment. The dsx, dsz and sbx corrections are filled in below, then the GUI asks before applying all three.
widgets.pb_mll_sample_in: Bring the MLL sample back: sbx +4000 µm. Requires sbz near +5000 (sample out); sbz itself is not moved back.
widgets.pb_mll_sample_out: Retract the MLL sample for exchange: sbz +5000 µm, dsth to 0°, then sbx -4000 µm. The XRF detector must be out (fdet1 x below -50 mm) first.
widgets.pb_mll_stop_all_sample: Stop all MLL motion immediately: lenses, OSA, beam stops and sample stages.
widgets.pb_mll_z_focus_move: Move sbz to the value on the left (absolute). Always sbz, whatever the motor menu shows. Moves immediately, without confirmation.
widgets.pb_mll_z_focus_start: Run the focus series. The line scan follows the edge if it drifts less than 12 µm. The z motor returns to its start position, then the GUI shows the best focus and asks before moving there.
widgets.pb_mlls_to_downstream: Move the lenses back to the working position: hmll hz by +8000 µm, then vmll vz by +10000 µm. Requires the lenses upstream and OSA Z near 0.
widgets.pb_mlls_to_upstream: Move the lenses upstream, away from the sample: vmll vz by -10000 µm, then hmll hz by -8000 µm. Do this before moving the sample out.
widgets.pb_move_data_to_globus: End of experiment: copy the user data folder to the proposal folder so users can download it with Globus. Opens a terminal running the copy. Warning: the copy currently starts even if you answer No.
widgets.pb_move_diff: Move the detector stage to the angles and distance above. Asks first, then opens the hutch camera page. Refused if the Dexela is in.
widgets.pb_move_diff_z: Move diff z by the value on the left (relative). Opens the hutch camera page and asks first.
widgets.pb_move_dsx_neg: Move dsx by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_dsx_pos: Move dsx by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_dsy_neg: Move dsy by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_dsy_pos: Move dsy by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_dsz_neg: Move dsz by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_dsz_pos: Move dsz by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_dth_pos: Move dsth by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_dth_pos_neg: Move dsth by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_energy: Move to the target energy: undulator gap and mono, then DCM pitch and roll, HFM pitch, detector energy settings and mirror coating. Asks to insert the front-end camera, then asks to confirm.
widgets.pb_move_pos_mll: Move the MLL sample stages to the selected saved position. Moves immediately, without confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_pos_zp: Move the ZP sample stages to the selected saved position. Moves immediately, without confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_s5: Move both S5 gaps to the SET values. The center does not change.
widgets.pb_move_sbx_neg: Move sbx by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_sbx_pos: Move sbx by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_sbz_neg: Move sbz by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_sbz_pos: Move sbz by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_smarx_neg: Move smarx by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_smarx_pos: Move smarx by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_smary_neg: Move smary by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_smary_pos: Move smary by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_smarz_neg: Move smarz by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_smarz_pos: Move smarz by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_ssa2: Move both SSA2 gaps to the SET values. The center does not change.
widgets.pb_move_zpsth_pos: Move zpsth by plus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_zpsth_pos_neg: Move zpsth by minus the step size (relative). No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_zpz_neg: Move ZPZ1 (zone plate focus) by minus the step size. No confirmation.
widgets.pb_move_zpz_pos: Move ZPZ1 (zone plate focus) by plus the step size. No confirmation.
widgets.pb_movezpz1_energy: Move ZPZ1 to the estimated focus for the new energy (absolute). Asks first.
widgets.pb_osa_in: Move the ZP OSA in: OSA Y moves by -2700 µm to its working position near 0. Refused if the OSA is already in. (The button label shows +2700; the plan moves -2700.)
widgets.pb_osa_out: Move the ZP OSA out: OSA Y moves by +2700 µm. Refused if the OSA is not near its IN position. (The button label shows -2700; the plan moves +2700.)
widgets.pb_peakBeamXY: Maximize the flux on the sample: scans the C-BPM set points in y, x, then y again and keeps the IC3 maximum. Move CAM06 out first; the plan stops if it is in.
widgets.pb_plot: Plot the element signal for the scan, normalized by the ion chamber (sclr1_ch4).
widgets.pb_plot_last: Put the most recent scan ID in the box.
widgets.pb_plot_line_center: Find the center of the element signal in a line scan, ignoring signal below the threshold.
widgets.pb_pos_to_angle: Convert the Dexela pixel to detector angles and 2-theta, using the Dexela calibration. Fills in the fields below.
widgets.pb_print_scan_meta_mll: Show the scan's start metadata (plan, detectors, user, sample).
widgets.pb_print_scan_meta_zp: Show the scan's start metadata (plan, detectors, user, sample).
widgets.pb_read_dexela_ROI1: Read the peak pixel from the top-right corner of Dexela ROI1, then calculate the detector angles. Place ROI1 so its top-right corner is on the peak first.
widgets.pb_recover_from_beamdump: Use after the storage ring beam returns. Turns beam feedback off, restores the DCM pitch/roll and feedback settings, turns XBPM feedback back on, then peaks the flux.
widgets.pb_recover_scan_pos_mll: Move the MLL sample stages back to where that scan was taken. Asks first if the scan is more than 100 scans old.
widgets.pb_recover_scan_pos_zp: Move the ZP sample stages back to where that scan was taken. No confirmation.
widgets.pb_reset_dexela_ROI1: Reset Dexela ROI1 to the upper-left quarter of the image (972 x 768 pixels).
widgets.pb_roiList_clear_mll: Remove all saved positions from the list. Export the list first if you need it.
widgets.pb_roiList_clear_sel_mll: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_roiList_clear_sel_zp: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_roiList_clear_zp: Remove all saved positions from the list. Export the list first if you need it.
widgets.pb_roiList_export_mll: Save the position list to a JSON file you choose.
widgets.pb_roiList_export_zp: Save the position list to a JSON file you choose.
widgets.pb_roiList_import_mll: Load a position list from a JSON file.
widgets.pb_roiList_import_zp: Load a position list from a JSON file.
widgets.pb_rot_align_all_move: Apply all corrections. Not connected yet: clicking does nothing. Corrections are applied when you answer Yes after Start.
widgets.pb_rot_align_dsth_move: Move dsth by the value on the left. Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_rot_align_dsx_move: Move dsx by the value on the left. Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_rot_align_dsz_move: Move dsz by the value on the left. Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_rot_align_sbx_move: Move sbx by the value on the left. Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_s5_hcen_move_neg: Move the S5 horizontal center by minus the step size. The gap does not change.
widgets.pb_s5_hcen_move_positive: Move the S5 horizontal center by plus the step size. The gap does not change.
widgets.pb_s5_vcen_move_neg: Move the S5 vertical center by minus the step size. The gap does not change.
widgets.pb_s5_vcen_move_positive: Move the S5 vertical center by plus the step size. The gap does not change.
widgets.pb_save_pos_mll: Add the current MLL sample stage positions (coarse, fine and rotation) to the list.
widgets.pb_save_pos_zp: Add the current ZP sample stage positions (coarse, fine and rotation) to the list.
widgets.pb_scan_copy: Copy the scan command, ready to paste into the bsui terminal.
widgets.pb_show_scan_pos_mll: Show the stage positions recorded with that scan. Nothing moves.
widgets.pb_show_scan_pos_zp: Show the stage positions recorded with that scan. Nothing moves.
widgets.pb_ssa2_hcen_move_neg: Move the SSA2 horizontal center by minus the step size. The gap does not change.
widgets.pb_ssa2_hcen_move_positive: Move the SSA2 horizontal center by plus the step size. The gap does not change.
widgets.pb_ssa2_vcen_move_neg: Move the SSA2 vertical center by minus the step size. The gap does not change.
widgets.pb_ssa2_vcen_move_positive: Move the SSA2 vertical center by plus the step size. The gap does not change.
widgets.pb_stop_cam11: Stop the detector stage (diff) immediately. Same as Stop Merlin/Eiger: both stop the whole stage.
widgets.pb_stop_fluor: Stop the XRF detector motion immediately.
widgets.pb_stop_merlin: Stop the detector stage (diff) immediately. Same as Stop CAM11: both stop the whole stage.
widgets.pb_stop_mll_motion: Stop all MLL stages. Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_telescope: Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_tomo_live_load: View another scan: choose its angle log (<scan_label>_startID<scan>.csv in save_log_to). Run follows the log of the scan it starts automatically.
widgets.pb_tomo_live_update: Check the angle log now and load any new angles. Loading runs in the background; the GUI stays usable.
widgets.pb_update_dets_pos: Disabled. Detector positions are edited in diff_det_pos.json in the profile startup folder.
widgets.pb_update_xrf_elems: Save the element selection as the beamline default and restart the GUI to load it. Asks first, and refuses while a scan is running.
widgets.pb_vortexIN: Move the XRF detector (fdet1 x) to the IN position set on the right. No confirmation.
widgets.pb_vortexOUT: Move the XRF detector (fdet1 x) out to -107 mm. No confirmation.
widgets.pb_zp_cam11_view: Switch the ZP microscope to CAM11 view. Closes the fast shutter, moves CAM06 out, opens SSA2 to 2 x 2 mm and S5 to 4 x 4 mm, moves CAM11 in, moves the OSA and beam stop out, then opens the fast shutter. Requires the OSA and beam stop in.
widgets.pb_zp_nanobeam: Switch the ZP microscope from CAM11 view to nanobeam. Closes the fast shutter, sets SSA2 to 0.05 x 0.03 mm and S5 to 0.3 x 0.3 mm, then moves the OSA and beam stop in. Requires the OSA and beam stop to be out.
widgets.pb_zp_rot_align_start: Run the rotation alignment. The x and z corrections are filled in below, then the GUI asks before applying them.
widgets.pb_zp_rot_move_smarx: Move smarX by the value on the right. Not connected yet: clicking does nothing. Use Apply Rot. Align. Correction.
widgets.pb_zp_rot_move_smarz: Move smarZ by the value on the right. Not connected yet: clicking does nothing. Use Apply Rot. Align. Correction.
widgets.pb_zp_rot_rotate_to: Rotate zpsth to the angle on the right. Not connected yet: clicking does nothing.
widgets.pb_zp_stop_all_sample: Stop all ZP motion immediately: zone plate, OSA, beam stop and sample stages.
widgets.pb_zpbsy_in: Move the ZP beam stop in: beam stop Y moves by -100 µm to near 0. Refused if it is already in. (The button label shows +100; the plan moves -100.)
widgets.pb_zpbsy_out: Move the ZP beam stop out: beam stop Y moves by +100 µm. Refused unless the beam stop is near 0. (The button label shows -100; the plan moves +100.)
widgets.pbar_diff_progress: Angles finished out of those planned for the diffraction scan started with Run. Checked every fifth of the time per angle (2-30 s); every 5 s until the first angle finishes.
widgets.pbar_tomo_progress: Angles finished out of those planned for the tomo scan started with Run. Checked every fifth of the time per angle (2-30 s); every 5 s until the first angle finishes.
widgets.rb_1d: Line scan (fly1dpd) with the first motor only.
widgets.rb_2d: 2D map (fly2dpd): the first motor scans each line, the second motor steps between lines.
widgets.rb_mll_manual_roi: Shows the active microscope (set with the Microscope selector at the top right). The motor names below follow it.
widgets.rb_zp_manual_roi: Shows the active microscope (set with the Microscope selector at the top right). The motor names below follow it.
widgets.sb_FocusScanMtrEnd: Line scan end, in µm, relative to the current position.
widgets.sb_FocusScanMtrStart: Line scan start, in µm, relative to the current position.
widgets.sb_FocusScanMtrStep: Number of points in each line scan. Fine steps give a better edge fit.
widgets.sb_ZPZ1RelativeEnd: Last ZPZ1 position, relative to the current position, in µm.
widgets.sb_ZPZ1RelativeStart: First ZPZ1 position, relative to the current position, in µm.
widgets.sb_ZPZ1Steps: Number of ZPZ1 steps. The series runs this many plus one line scans.
widgets.sb_calc_harmonic: Harmonic that will be used for the target energy.
widgets.sb_energy_sid: Scan ID whose recorded energy, undulator gap and mono pitch you want to return to.
widgets.sb_harmonic: Undulator harmonic to use. -1 picks the harmonic automatically. Updates the estimates below.
widgets.sb_live_elem_num: How many of the selected elements (counting from box 1) are shown in the live 2D plots.
widgets.sb_max_iter: Maximum number of Find Beam at SSA2 attempts.
widgets.sb_mll_rot_angle_end: Last rotation angle (dsth), in degrees. Wider ranges give a more reliable fit.
widgets.sb_mll_rot_angle_num: Number of angle steps. The alignment runs this many plus one line scans.
widgets.sb_mll_rot_scan_exp_time: Dwell time per point, in seconds.
widgets.sb_mll_rot_scan_exp_time_2: 0-1. Signal below this fraction of the maximum is ignored when finding the center.
widgets.sb_mll_rot_scan_num: Number of points in each line scan.
widgets.sb_mll_rot_scan_start_2: Line scan start, in µm. dssx is scanned below 45° and dssz above; both are set to 0 before each scan.
widgets.sb_mll_z_end: Last z position, relative to the current position, in µm.
widgets.sb_mll_z_start: First z position, relative to the current position, in µm.
widgets.sb_mll_z_steps: Number of z steps. The series runs this many plus one line scans.
widgets.sb_zp_rot_angle_end: Last rotation angle (zpsth), in degrees. Wider ranges give a more reliable fit.
widgets.sb_zp_rot_angle_num: Number of angle steps. The alignment runs this many plus one line scans.
widgets.sb_zp_rot_scan_exp_time: Dwell time per point, in seconds.
widgets.sb_zp_rot_scan_num: Number of points in each line scan.
widgets.sb_zp_rot_scan_start: Line scan start, in µm. zpssx is scanned below 45° and zpssz above, so the range must cover the feature at every angle.
widgets.sl_tomo_live_angle: Step through the angles. Moves all four images together.
widgets.sp_dexela_xpixel: Dexela x pixel of the diffraction peak. Fill in by hand or with Read Dexela ROI1.
widgets.sp_dexela_ypixel: Dexela y pixel of the diffraction peak (counted from the bottom of the image).
widgets.sp_diff_det_calc_2theta: Scattering angle 2-theta for the peak, in degrees. For reference; not used to move.
widgets.sp_diff_det_calc_x: Detector in-plane angle (gamma), in degrees. Filled in by Calculate Diff. Pos.; you can edit it.
widgets.sp_diff_det_calc_y: Detector out-of-plane angle (delta), in degrees. Filled in by Calculate Diff. Pos.; you can edit it.
widgets.sp_diff_det_r: Sample-to-detector distance for the move, in mm.
widgets.start: Run the scan. Offers to open the photon shutter if it is closed, and warns if the XRF detector is out. The plot updates live.
widgets.text_scan_plan: The Bluesky command this scan runs. Updates as you edit the values above.
widgets.x_end: End of the first motor range, in µm, relative to the current position.
widgets.x_start: Start of the first motor range, in µm, relative to the current position.
widgets.x_step: Number of points along the first motor.
widgets.y_end: End of the second motor range, in µm, relative to the current position.
widgets.y_start: Start of the second motor range, in µm, relative to the current position.
widgets.y_step: Number of lines along the second motor. Total points (x times y) cannot exceed 64,000.
widgets.zp_sample_roi_list_widget: Saved ZP sample positions. Double-click a name to rename it. The list is also saved automatically to /data/users/current_user/temp.
